crew.overview: Four men from different parts of the globe, all hiding from their pasts in the same remote South American town, agree to risk their lives transporting several cases of dynamite (which is so old that it is dripping unstable nitroglycerin) across dangerous jungle terrain.
crew.title: Sorcerer

details.biography: Richard Henry Bush (June 24, 1931 – August 4, 1997) was a prolific British cinematographer whose career spanned over thirty years. He was a frequent collaborator of directors Ken Russell and Blake Edwards.
details.name: Dick Bush
